# `/identities-accounts` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /identities-accounts/v1/{id}/enable

`enableAccountForIdentityV1` — Enable idn account for identity

This API submits a task to enable IDN account for a single identity.

- Scopes: idn:accounts-provisioning:manage, idn:accounts-state:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The identity id.
- Returns 202: object

### POST /identities-accounts/v1/{id}/disable

`disableAccountForIdentityV1` — Disable idn account for identity

This API submits a task to disable IDN account for a single identity.

- Scopes: idn:accounts-provisioning:manage, idn:accounts-state:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The identity id.
- Returns 202: object

### POST /identities-accounts/v1/enable

`enableAccountsForIdentitiesV1` — Enable idn accounts for identities

This API submits tasks to enable IDN account for each identity provided in the request body.

- Scopes: idn:accounts-provisioning:manage, idn:accounts-state:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): identitiesaccountsbulkrequest

### POST /identities-accounts/v1/disable

`disableAccountsForIdentitiesV1` — Disable idn accounts for identities

This API submits tasks to disable IDN account for each identity provided in the request body.

- Scopes: idn:accounts-provisioning:manage, idn:accounts-state:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): identitiesaccountsbulkrequest
